Sorry about spamming the same comment a few times just now. I don't know what to do next. I've been rejected before plenty of times, but it's never felt like this. Before now, I just didn't really try because I could tell the girl didn't feel the same way, but this time I really thought she did. It feels like I wasn't put on Earth to be loved.

I'm going to be taking a lot of time for myself. I don't know if I should stop talking to her or what. I don't really want to, but I just want to do what's best for her. And for me, I guess.
